verdict.rationale: Zero documents connecting to existing providers such as Gmail and Outlook through its unified inbox. That reads mail in place at the provider, which is an adjacent feature rather than an import or migration of history from an old provider or client. Nothing in the evidence describes importing mail archives (mbox/PST/IMAP migration) or importing contacts.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
